name: proved_outranks_capability_spam
description: Trimmed Camazotz-shaped scan: OOB/reproduced vs excessive_permissions pile

findings.title: [AI] [MCP-T51] Chain exfiltrated data (out-of-band confirmed): Direct SSRF/data exfiltration via egress.fetch_url
findings.detail: Chain exfiltrated data out-of-band (chain.get_service_manifest → egress.fetch_url). The target reached the canary URL from 127.0.0.1, which appeared nowhere except this replay. The AI-gated egress proxy is asked to fetch a URL under attacker control; if it resolves, sensitive context can be smuggled in the URL/query and a callback confirms data left the target.

findings.title: [AI] [MCP-T14] Chain exfiltrated data (out-of-band confirmed): Webhook registration + trigger to exfiltrate secrets out-of-band
findings.detail: Chain exfiltrated data out-of-band (secrets.leak_config → shadow.register_webhook → notification.trigger_event). The target reached the canary URL from 127.0.0.1, which appeared nowhere except this replay. A webhook is registered against attacker infrastructure, and a subsequent event trigger causes the server to call out and deliver secret-bearing notification payloads to the listener.

findings.title: [AI] [MCP-T21] Chain reproduced: Credential forwarding across agent hops via chain.call_downstream
findings.detail: Chain reproduced end to end (chain.get_service_manifest → chain.call_downstream → chain.inspect_audit_log). Output of step 0 appeared in the request to step 1. Agent A forwards a caller-supplied credential directly to Agent B's REST API. Agent B trusts the forwarded token's claims with no re-authentication, enabling privilege escalation across the trust boundary.

findings.title: [AI] [MCP-T51] Chain reproduced: SSRF via CDN asset registration to internal/OOB endpoint
findings.detail: Chain reproduced end to end (gateway.register_asset → gateway.fetch_content). Output of step 0 appeared in the request to step 1. gateway.register_asset accepts any URL with no AI review, minting a cdn.internal token; fetch_content then resolves it, proving an SSRF path that can be pointed at an out-of-band listener to confirm egress.

findings.title: [AI] [MCP-T12] Chain reproduced: Exfiltration of internal manifest via unsigned comms relay
findings.detail: Chain reproduced end to end (chain.get_service_manifest → relay.store_context → comms.send_message). Output of step 0 appeared in the request to step 1. Chain manifest data (agent topology, identity/credential forwarding rules) is stored in the shared context buffer and then composed into an outbound message with no verification, proving a live exfil path.
